narrative.overview: An immersive photographic invitation, with expressive serif headlines, disciplined interface typography and generous breathing room. Warm ivory pages alternate with an ink-dark lookbook; subtle champagne details support the photographs. The active HTML storefront is an inspiration gallery, with genuine discovery, detail zoom and a shared saved-selection notebook.

rules.name: Rare Champagne
rules.body: Reserve bronze for focus and small accents; photography and ink/ivory establish the hierarchy.

rules.name: Editorial Type
rules.body: Use Cormorant Garamond for expressive headings and locally hosted Inter for interface copy.

rules.name: Flat Surfaces
rules.body: Create depth through photography, tone, fine rules and modal backdrops rather than decorative card shadows.

dos: Do preserve French copy and inspiration disclosures.
Do share favorites across cards, quick-view, drawer and printable notebook.
Do preserve keyboard focus and touch access.
donts: Don't invent inventory, product facts, prices or payment flows.
Don't apply the archived React homepage's visual system to the active route.
Don't require hover or animation to use controls.
